_comment: BUB1B variants recovered from the primary literature via Paperclip that are NOT in the EBI/ClinVar aggregate, plus literature context for ones that are. Each entry cites the PMC id it was read from.

variants.phenotype: embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, IUGR, microcephaly; complex mosaic aneuploidy + PCS on karyotype
PCS/MVA: FGR, microcephaly, congenital cataracts, ambiguous genitalia
variants.functional: RT-PCR showed exon skipping and reduced transcript

variants.partner: missense on the other allele in MVA patients
variants.phenotype: MVA; the allele modelled in BubR1+/GTTA mice
variants.zygosity: biallelic in patients, monoallelic in the mouse model
variants.functional: truncated protein UNDETECTABLE by western blot; wild-type BubR1 reduced

variants.phenotype: breast cancer, family history of prostate/ovarian/gastric
familial prostate cancer; PCS present
variants.functional: tumour RNA-seq for BUB1B expression; PCS in lymphocytes

variants.phenotype: breast + gastric signet-ring carcinoma

variants.partner: compound het with p.Glu391del in CRISPR RWPE-1 models only
variants.phenotype: engineered cell model, not a patient allele
early-onset/familial prostate cancer, multiple other cancers; PCS trait
variants.functional: MEASURED: strong reduction of BubR1 abundance in mitotic cells; CHX chase; impaired SAC; taxol resistance

variants.phenotype: recurrent pregnancy loss; PCS 18.58% by PNA-FISH
variants.functional: PRELIMINARY ONLY - authors state a 'trend toward' reduced mRNA and protein, explicitly not definitive quantification; unaffected father shows the same trend

variants.phenotype: recurrent pregnancy loss; PCS
variants.functional: PRELIMINARY ONLY - same qualitative western blot caveat as A739S

variants.phenotype: MVA1 phenotype with 12% mosaic aneuploidy
variants.zygosity: heterozygous; ALSO PRESENT IN THE UNAFFECTED FATHER
variants.functional: not measured; pathogenicity asserted from in silico only

variants.phenotype: none - in silico screen only, no patient
none - in silico screen only, no patient
gastric cancer risk polymorphism, KEN/CDC20-binding region
variants.note: NOTATION CONFLICT: UniProt curates VAR_008853 at this codon as p.Arg349Gln and calls it BENIGN. Reciprocal notation - reference allele assignment differs between sources. Do not treat as two variants without resolving.

variants.phenotype: serrated polyposis syndrome patient; assessed benign
fetal structural anomalies (absent nasal bone, hypertelorism); gene linked to PCS/MVA1
variants.note: Found only by the Europe PMC full-text sweep; absent from ClinVar/EBI. Note c.2405_2406 is the SAME codon pair as the c.2405_2406del (p.Ser802Cysfs*29) allele in PMC10545765 - a different event at one hotspot.

variants.phenotype: lung cancer, Colombian hereditary-cancer germline programme
variants.note: Same paper independently reports BUB1B c.199C>T p.(Arg67Ter) in breast and ovarian cancer patients.

variants.phenotype: germline variant in a NON-SMOKING non-small-cell lung cancer inherited-signature study (Cancers 2024)
variants.note: Pseudokinase domain. The EBI atlas carries V870M at this codon but not V870A. AUDIT: earlier description 'tumour-suppressor variant table, cancer genomics cohort' was wrong at source.

variants.phenotype: found in a cutaneous-melanoma-with-two-or-more-primary-cancers germline cohort (PLoS One 2018); rsID rs750364303
variants.functional: not measured. The PCS attribution is SECONDHAND - the paper says 'as previously described could cause premature chromatid separation trait', citing prior work rather than showing it.
variants.note: INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION that codon 770 carries a nonsense allele distinct from R770Q. Our VARIANT-TABLE.md architectural-match argument is built on R770Q and must be re-checked against its primary source.

variants.phenotype: sudden unexpected postnatal collapse (SUPC) with hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy; died at 6 months of sepsis from bronchopneumonia. NOT an MVA diagnosis.
variants.zygosity: compound heterozygous; R770Q maternal, R194Ter paternal
variants.functional: NOT measured. Authors classify it a VUS (ACMG class 3) and state it 'is not reported in scientific literature'. They write: 'it is not possible to demonstrate the causal effect of this mutation'.
variants.note: RESOLVES the R770 flag. R770Q (c.2309G>A, rs1422532977) and R770Ter (c.2308C>T, rs750364303) are TWO DIFFERENT VARIANTS at ADJACENT NUCLEOTIDES of one codon. Our corpus's R770Q is correctly transcribed and is not a mis-parse of the nonsense allele. But the 'ARCHITECTURAL MATCH' framing overstates it: this is a VUS in a non-MVA presentation whose own authors disclaim causality.
